page.title: 6 Days That Change Your Trajectory
page.lead: A curated itinerary for African leaders. Between academic sessions at Stanford, meetings with tech giants, and strategic networking, discover the future of tech leadership.

items.description: Private transfer to the Palace Hotel, San Francisco.
Welcome dinner and networking among participants.
Lunch at the Stanford Faculty Club.
Meeting with African researchers based in Silicon Valley.
Apple Park Visitor Center: the obsession with design and experience.
Meta HQ: the future of social media and connectivity in Africa.
Nvidia: immersion in the GPU and deep learning revolution.
Networking night with Sand Hill Road investors.
VIP visit: Levi's Stadium (tech & smart venue).
Tesla Factory: automation and the future of energy.
Closing ceremony and Silicon Valley Africa certificate presentation.
Transfer to SFO airport for departures.

page.title: Who Can Apply?
page.lead: The Silicon Valley Africa Program is designed for visionaries, entrepreneurs, and decision-makers looking to bring Californian tech excellence into the African ecosystem. We're looking for profiles with strong potential for impact.

eligibleItems: Entrepreneurs with a minimum viable product (MVP) or in a scale-up phase.
Executives and heads of innovation (CTO, CDO, CEO).
Investors and African venture capital fund managers.
Final-year students or recent graduates with a structured tech project.
ineligibleItems: Profiles with no direct link to the tech or entrepreneurial sector.
Projects with no intention of implementation on the African continent.
Candidates without working proficiency in technical English (recommended).

pillar1.title: Motivation
pillar1.description: Beyond skills, we measure the drive to durably transform the sector. Your "why" is what sparks our interest.

pillar2.title: Social Impact
pillar2.description: The project must address a concrete African challenge: financial inclusion, education, health, or digital infrastructure.

pillar3.title: Return To The Continent
pillar3.description: A moral or contractual commitment to apply what you've learned on the continent to generate local value.

statuses.title: Two Statuses, One Goal
